nodes.avoid_direction: Avoid over-committing to economy at the expense of defense. Do not neglect scouting or assume the opponent is passive.
nodes.decision_direction: Prioritize safety by building a few defensive units (Zerglings or Spine Crawlers) while continuing to develop your economy. Maintain scouting to detect any early pressure.
nodes.exit_or_recheck_condition: Re-evaluate when you have a few defensive units and scouting confirms the opponent is not rushing. If you see a large Zergling force, prepare for defense.
nodes.next_state_summary: Proceed to a more stable early-midgame state with a stronger economy and army presence.
nodes.opponent_situation: The opponent appears to be on a similar economy-focused path, but their defensive posture is light or uncertain. They may be planning an early attack or expanding quickly.
nodes.own_situation: You have a heavy economy focus with light defense and moderate production. Your army is small, mostly Queens, and you are vulnerable to early aggression.
nodes.strategic_reason: In ZvZ, early game aggression can be deadly. Investing in a small defensive force prevents being caught off guard while you establish your economy.
nodes.title: Early Game Vulnerability
nodes.transition_goal: Transition into a stable early-midgame with a solid economy and a modest army to deter attacks.
nodes.trigger_summary: At the start of the game, both players are in the early game with light defenses and uncertain technology. The opponent may be preparing an early pressure or rush.

nodes.avoid_direction: Avoid unnecessary aggression that could cost you drones. Do not neglect scouting for tech switches or all-ins.
nodes.decision_direction: Continue developing your economy and army. Add more production structures (Hatcheries) and consider teching up to Roaches or other units. Maintain creep spread and map vision.
nodes.exit_or_recheck_condition: Re-evaluate when you have a comfortable army size and are ready to tech up. If the opponent shows signs of aggression, adjust accordingly.
nodes.next_state_summary: Move towards a midgame state with a heavier army and potential tech investment.
nodes.opponent_situation: The opponent has a heavy defense and economy, with Zerglings and Queens. They appear to be focusing on macro and may be preparing for a midgame army.
nodes.own_situation: You have a heavy economy and are producing Zerglings and Queens. Your defense is light, but your production is moderate. You are in a good position to continue expanding.
nodes.strategic_reason: A macro-oriented approach in ZvZ often leads to a midgame army composition. Building a strong economy now will allow you to outproduce the opponent later.
nodes.title: Early-Midgame Macro
nodes.transition_goal: Transition into the midgame with a strong economy and a versatile army composition.
nodes.trigger_summary: The game has progressed to the early-midgame. Both players have expanded and are producing Zerglings and Queens. The opponent's defense is heavy, suggesting a macro-oriented approach.

nodes.avoid_direction: Avoid over-investing in Roaches if the opponent is teching to air. Do not forget to expand and maintain your economy.
nodes.decision_direction: Strengthen your ground army by adding more Roaches and upgrading their attacks and armor. Consider adding a few Overseers for detection. Maintain map control and watch for flanks.
nodes.exit_or_recheck_condition: Re-evaluate when you have a large Roach force and are ready to attack or transition. If the opponent shows air units, consider adding Hydralisks or Mutalisks.
nodes.next_state_summary: Proceed to a late-midgame state with a strong ground army and possible tech advancements.
nodes.opponent_situation: The opponent has a heavy production and moderate technology, with Zerglings and Queens. They may be preparing for a Roach push or a tech switch.
nodes.own_situation: You have a heavy economy and a moderate production. Your army consists of Zerglings, Roaches, and Queens. Your technology is light, but you are in a good position to upgrade.
nodes.strategic_reason: Roaches are a strong midgame unit in ZvZ. Upgrading them gives you a significant advantage in army trades.
nodes.title: Midgame Ground Army
nodes.transition_goal: Transition into a late-midgame with a powerful ground army and potential for tech upgrades.
nodes.trigger_summary: The game has reached the midgame. The opponent has a heavy production and moderate technology, with Zerglings and Queens. You have added Roaches to your composition.

nodes.avoid_direction: Avoid falling too far behind in economy. Do not make unnecessary units that could be drones.
nodes.decision_direction: Focus on catching up in economy by expanding and building more drones. Maintain a small defensive force to deter attacks. Consider teching up to Roaches for safety.
nodes.exit_or_recheck_condition: Re-evaluate when your economy is on par with the opponent. If you are being pressured, build more units.
nodes.next_state_summary: Move towards an early-midgame state with a stronger economy.
nodes.opponent_situation: The opponent has a heavy economy and defense, with Zerglings and Queens. They are likely focusing on macro and may be ahead in workers.
nodes.own_situation: You have a moderate economy and light expansion. Your army consists of Zerglings and Queens. You are slightly behind in economy compared to the opponent.
nodes.strategic_reason: In a macro game, economy is king. Catching up in workers will allow you to compete in the midgame.
nodes.title: Early Game Economy Focus
nodes.transition_goal: Transition into a stable early-midgame with a competitive economy.
nodes.trigger_summary: In the early game, you have a moderate economy and light expansion, while the opponent has a heavy economy and defense. This suggests a macro-oriented game.

nodes.avoid_direction: Avoid being caught off guard by a tech switch to air. Do not neglect scouting for Mutalisks or Brood Lords.
nodes.decision_direction: Continue strengthening your ground army. Upgrade Roach attacks and armor. Consider adding a few Infestors or Ultralisks for late-game power. Maintain map control and vision.
nodes.exit_or_recheck_condition: Re-evaluate when you have a significant army advantage or are ready to attack. If the opponent transitions to air, adapt accordingly.
nodes.next_state_summary: Proceed to a late-game state with a strong army and potential for victory.
nodes.opponent_situation: The opponent has a heavy economy and production, with a similar army composition. They may be preparing for a large engagement or a tech switch.
nodes.own_situation: You have a heavy economy and production. Your army is strong with Zerglings, Roaches, and Queens. Your technology is moderate, and you are in a good position to upgrade.
nodes.strategic_reason: In the late-midgame, upgrades and army composition are crucial. A well-upgraded Roach army can be very cost-effective.
nodes.title: Late-Midgame Ground Dominance
nodes.transition_goal: Transition into the late game with a powerful army and tech advantage.
nodes.trigger_summary: The game has reached the late-midgame. Both players have heavy economies and armies consisting of Zerglings, Roaches, and Queens. The opponent's technology is moderate.

nodes.avoid_direction: Avoid engaging in large ground battles where the opponent has the advantage. Do not over-commit to Mutalisks if the opponent is teching to Hydralisks or Spore Crawlers.
nodes.decision_direction: Continue building Mutalisks and harass the opponent's economy. Use your air advantage to control the map and force the opponent to react. Consider adding Corruptors if the opponent builds anti-air.
nodes.exit_or_recheck_condition: Re-evaluate when the opponent has sufficient anti-air. If they do, consider transitioning back to ground or adding Corruptors.
nodes.next_state_summary: Move towards a late-game state with air superiority.
nodes.opponent_situation: The opponent has a heavy ground army with Zerglings, Roaches, and Queens. They may not have anti-air units, making them vulnerable to Mutalisks.
nodes.own_situation: You have a heavy economy and production. Your army includes Zerglings, Mutalisks, Queens, and Overseers. Your technology is moderate, and you are investing in air upgrades.
nodes.strategic_reason: Mutalisks are highly mobile and can deal significant damage if the opponent lacks anti-air. This can give you a strong economic advantage.
nodes.title: Air Transition
nodes.transition_goal: Transition into a late-game state with air dominance and a strong economy.
nodes.trigger_summary: In the late-midgame, you have transitioned to a heavy air presence with Mutalisks and Overseers, while the opponent remains ground-focused with Zerglings, Roaches, and Queens.

nodes.avoid_direction: Avoid losing your Mutalisks to anti-air units. Do not neglect your ground defense.
nodes.decision_direction: Use Mutalisks to harass the opponent's workers and expansions. Keep your Mutalisk count high and avoid engaging in unfavorable ground fights. Continue expanding and teching.
nodes.exit_or_recheck_condition: Re-evaluate when the opponent has sufficient anti-air. If they do, consider transitioning to ground or adding Corruptors.
nodes.next_state_summary: Proceed to a late-midgame state with air superiority.
nodes.opponent_situation: The opponent has a heavy ground army with Zerglings, Roaches, and Queens. They may be vulnerable to air harassment.
nodes.own_situation: You have a heavy economy and production. Your army includes Zerglings, Mutalisks, Queens, and Overseers. Your technology is moderate.
nodes.strategic_reason: Mutalisk harassment can cripple the opponent's economy and force them to make defensive units, giving you a strategic advantage.
nodes.title: Midgame Air Harassment
nodes.transition_goal: Transition into a late-midgame state with air dominance and a strong economy.
nodes.trigger_summary: In the midgame, you have a heavy air presence with Mutalisks and Overseers, while the opponent has a heavy ground army with Zerglings, Roaches, and Queens.

nodes.avoid_direction: Avoid being caught off guard by a ground attack while focusing on air defense. Do not neglect your economy.
nodes.decision_direction: Focus on defense by building Spore Crawlers and Hydralisks to counter air threats. Maintain a strong ground army to defend against any ground attacks. Consider adding Corruptors of your own.
nodes.exit_or_recheck_condition: Re-evaluate when you have sufficient anti-air and are ready to counterattack. If the opponent transitions to ground, adjust accordingly.
nodes.next_state_summary: Move towards a late-game state with a balanced defense.
nodes.opponent_situation: The opponent has a heavy air presence with Mutalisks and Corruptors, along with Zerglings and Queens. They may be planning an air attack.
nodes.own_situation: You have a heavy economy and production. Your army is ground-based with Zerglings, Roaches, Queens, and Overseers. Your technology is heavy.
nodes.strategic_reason: Defending against air attacks is crucial. Spore Crawlers and Hydralisks are effective against Mutalisks and Corruptors.
nodes.title: Defensive Stance
nodes.transition_goal: Transition into a stable late-game state with a balanced army.
nodes.trigger_summary: In the late-midgame, the opponent has a heavy air presence with Mutalisks and Corruptors, while you have a ground army with Zerglings, Roaches, and Queens. Your defense is heavy.

nodes.avoid_direction: Avoid over-committing to defense at the expense of economy. Do not forget to scout for tech switches.
nodes.decision_direction: Stabilize your defense by building Spine Crawlers and a few more Zerglings. Continue developing your economy and consider teching up to Roaches for safety.
nodes.exit_or_recheck_condition: Re-evaluate when your defense is sufficient and you are ready to tech up. If the opponent attacks, defend and counter.
nodes.next_state_summary: Proceed to a midgame state with a stable defense.
nodes.opponent_situation: The opponent has a heavy economy and defense, with Zerglings and Queens. They may be preparing for an attack or a tech switch.
nodes.own_situation: You have a heavy economy and production. Your army consists of Zerglings and Queens. Your defense is light, making you vulnerable to attacks.
nodes.strategic_reason: A stable defense allows you to develop your economy without fear of harassment.
nodes.title: Early-Midgame Stabilization
nodes.transition_goal: Transition into a stable midgame with a solid defense and economy.
nodes.trigger_summary: In the early-midgame, you have a heavy economy but light defense. The opponent has a heavy economy and defense, with Zerglings and Queens.

nodes.avoid_direction: Avoid being caught off guard by a ground attack while focusing on air defense. Do not neglect your economy.
nodes.decision_direction: Prepare for air defense by building Spore Crawlers and Hydralisks. Consider adding Corruptors to fight for air control. Maintain a strong ground army to defend against any ground attacks.
nodes.exit_or_recheck_condition: Re-evaluate when you have sufficient anti-air and are ready to counterattack. If the opponent transitions to ground, adjust accordingly.
nodes.next_state_summary: Move towards a late-midgame state with a balanced defense.
nodes.opponent_situation: The opponent has a heavy air presence with Mutalisks and Corruptors, along with Zerglings and Queens. They may be planning an air attack.
nodes.own_situation: You have a heavy economy and production. Your army is ground-based with Zerglings, Roaches, and Queens. Your technology is moderate.
nodes.strategic_reason: Air units can be devastating if not countered. Building anti-air units is essential to protect your economy and army.
nodes.title: Midgame Air Threat
nodes.transition_goal: Transition into a late-midgame state with a balanced army.
nodes.trigger_summary: In the midgame, the opponent has a heavy air presence with Mutalisks and Corruptors, while you have a ground army with Zerglings, Roaches, and Queens.

opening.flexibility_note: This is a strategic template, not a fixed build order. Adapt based on live scouting and opponent actions.
opening.opening_summary: A Zerg versus Zerg opening that prioritizes economy and ground army development with light early technology investment. The strategic posture is flexible, allowing adaptation to either a ground-heavy composition or a transition into air units like Mutalisks depending on scouting information.
opening.strategic_goal: Develop a strong economy and ground army while maintaining flexibility to transition into air or tech as needed. Focus on map control and creep spread to support a macro-oriented playstyle.
